title: BusyBox hush noninteractive shell with a native capability spawn process backend
workload: General shell parsing and execution through native spawn: commands, pipelines, substitutions, functions, heredocs and control flow; tests/semantics.sh and tests/child.c are independent shell fixtures.
status: Host clean build and native exchange/direct shell fixtures PASS, including 100001-byte heredoc streaming and 100 redirection-error cleanup iterations. Exact source/image/platform hashes and limits are recorded in results/native-task.json.
note: No fork/vfork backend or scalar shell fallback. Exact pinned /bin/sh file grant is supplied by the native loader. No interactive job control, caught traps, or in-place exec support; see README.md for the configured subset.
